# GetTAO

GetTAO (Get The Autonomous Operations) is a platform that runs business operations autonomously. Purpose-built agents handle the repetitive operational work across a team's existing tools, with human approval on every consequential action and a full audit trail.

## Primary pages and sections

- Website: https://gettao.io/
- Capabilities: https://gettao.io/#capabilities
- Why GetTAO: https://gettao.io/#why-gettao
- How it works: https://gettao.io/#how-it-works
- Use cases: https://gettao.io/#use-cases
- Pricing: https://gettao.io/#pricing
- Frequently asked questions: https://gettao.io/#faq
- Request access: https://gettao.io/#access

## Capabilities

- Autonomous agents: run recurring operational work — triage, reconciliation, reporting, follow-ups — on a schedule, inside customer-defined guardrails.
- Connected workflows: orchestrate work across CRM, helpdesk, databases, Slack, and email so information moves without manual handoffs.
- Human control: configurable approval gates, confidence thresholds, escalation paths, instant rollback, and a full audit trail on every action.

## The operating loop

Observe -> Reason -> Approve (human) -> Act -> Learn. The loop runs continuously; consequential actions pause for a human decision.
